sloka: प्रवृत्ते सङ्कुले तस्मिन् घोरे वीरजनक्षये।अङ्गदः कम्पनं वीरमाससाद रणोत्सुकः ।। ६.७६.१ ।।
transliteration: pravṛtte saṅkule tasmin ghore vīrajanakṣaye।aṅgadaḥ kampanaṁ vīramāsasāda raṇotsukaḥ ।। 6.76.1 ।।

translations.english: While the fierce fight brought destruction of heroes in the ongoing combat, Angada eager to fight, assailed gallant Kampana.
